Class NitriteConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.conf.NitriteConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.core.naming.Named
public class NitriteConfiguration extends Object implements io.micronaut.core.naming.Named
Configuration properties for a named NitriteDB datasource.

Example: 

micronaut:
  nitrite:
    default:
      db-path: /data/myapp.db
      storage-mode: MVSTORE
      create-indexes: true
      sorted-read-strategy: AUTO
      username: admin
      password: secret
Since:
5.2.0
